20 hours of its exercise, an hour a day, would take it from 54 to about 58. On your recent work, judged again as you are now, that’s forecast to be worth about 0.7 points a piece (your last 3 pieces all call on it; Tell Me What It Looks Like (Keep The Line Moving), Taped would gain most, about +0.8).
